about: List a firm or expert in the AD.iP directory of intellectual property service providers.
note: Requirements read from the official AD.iP service provider registration page on the checked date. The form is a public two-step web form, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: For IP law firms, law firms, consultancies, agencies, corporations, public bodies and associations
Each listed expert chooses a qualification, such as advocate, patent attorney, trademark attorney or IP consultant, and a jurisdiction
documents: Optional logo and team photos, up to 0.5 MB each in common image formats
Licence number, certifications, references and a description of up to 150 words
timing: The team replies after submission; no time is stated
channels: Online two-step form on the AD.iP page
